summary: Verified user's pepper/basil bg-hero.webp is loaded (natural 1600x2000, served via /assets/?unstable_path=./assets/images/bg-hero.webp) and NO opaque rgb(242,242,242) navigator wrapper remains — the ThemeProvider transparent fix works. Backend fully green: 41/41 pytest pass, GET /api/products returns 164, GET /api/products/{id} 200, product-detail Rules-of-Hooks fix intact (no hook errors when opening /product/[id]). BUT the transparent-everything approach introduced a NEW critical UI regression: **all tab screens bleed through each other**. When the Cart tab is active, the entire Home screen (FreshncuT logo, 'Deliver to Bengaluru' pill, 5-cat icon strip, 'Farm-fresh, cut on demand' video banner, 'Shop by category' cards, Subscribe & Save promo) renders VISIBLY behind the Cart UI ('My Basket' header, 'Your basket is empty' modal). DOM check confirmed 24 x 'Deliver to Bengaluru' elements and both 'My Basket' + 'Shop' titles simultaneously present when Cart is active — proving all 4 tab trees are mounted and painted on top of the aurora because (a) react-navigation ThemeProvider colors.card='transparent', (b) Tabs sceneContainerStyle: 'transparent', and (c) each tab screen root uses backgroundColor: 'transparent'. Nothing hides inactive tabs. Home tab in isolation renders clean and the pepper/basil aurora is subtly visible through the veil around the video banner / category strip / promo. Product detail opens without hook errors and background aurora is visible under the sticky Add-to-basket bar.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL — Tab screens bleed through: with ThemeProvider colors.card='transparent' + sceneContainerStyle: transparent + each screen root backgroundColor: 'transparent', react-navigation keeps all 4 tab trees mounted and visible at the same time. Cart shows Home content underneath (FreshncuT logo, category strip, video banner, subscribe promo). Same on Profile. Repro: open http://localhost:3000, tap Cart tab → Home tree remains visible behind. DOM confirms 24 x 'Deliver to Bengaluru' + duplicate My Basket/Shop titles. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:36 (sceneContainerStyle transparent) + /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:19-26 (TransparentNavTheme card:transparent).

issues: Pepper/basil aurora is present but heavily muted by the 32% white veil + LinearGradient sky base + LinearGradient scrim on the video banner. Only faint glimpses of the produce photo are visible around the edges of the category strip and around the Subscribe promo. If the intent is 'peek through', current opacity feels closer to 15%. Consider dropping the veil to ~20% or removing the sky-blue LinearGradient base (which is painted OVER the image on lines 15-20 of BackgroundAurora.tsx — this is the WRONG order; the RN Image on line 23 is drawn AFTER, so it wins, so the sky gradient underneath is invisible and only adds cost).

action_items: Fix tab bleed-through (CRITICAL). Add `unmountOnBlur: true` (or React Navigation v7's `detachInactiveScreens: true` / `freezeOnBlur: true`) to the Tabs screenOptions in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx. Alternative: revert TransparentNavTheme colors.card back to DefaultTheme.colors.card and rely solely on Stack contentStyle: transparent — but this may re-introduce the F2F2F2 wrapper on child screens, so unmountOnBlur is the recommended fix.

In BackgroundAurora.tsx: the LinearGradient on lines 15-20 (sky-blue base) is UNDER the RN Image (line 23) which uses resizeMode='cover' at full opacity — so the gradient is completely occluded. Either remove the gradient (dead paint) or move it above the image with reduced opacity if you want a color tint.
Consider dropping the white veil from rgba(255,255,255,0.32) → 0.20 so the peppers/basil are more visibly the 'app background' the user asked for.
critical_code_review_comments: app/_layout.tsx line 44 wraps everything in <View backgroundColor: '#EAF4FE'> — that base color is fine as fallback, but combined with the sky-blue LinearGradient inside BackgroundAurora it's double-paint that gets overridden by the cover image anyway.

Tabs sceneContainerStyle: 'transparent' is the direct cause of the visual bleed. Either use unmountOnBlur or set sceneContainerStyle back to a color while keeping only the Stack contentStyle transparent — react-navigation still renders TabView with all screens attached; transparency exposes them all.

success_rate.frontend: 75% — Home/Shop/Product-detail render clean; tab bleed-through breaks Cart & Profile screens

context_for_next_testing_agent: bg-hero.webp IS loaded (verified via DOM: naturalWidth=1600, src=/assets/?unstable_path=./assets/images/bg-hero.webp). No opaque F2F2F2 wrappers remain. Backend unchanged (164 products, all pytest pass). REMAINING BUG: tab bleed-through — Cart & Profile show Home content behind because ThemeProvider transparent + tabs stay mounted + all tab roots backgroundColor:transparent. Fix in (tabs)/_layout.tsx by adding unmountOnBlur/detachInactiveScreens/freezeOnBlur. After fix, re-verify: (1) tapping Cart hides Home tree, (2) 'Deliver to Bengaluru' element count drops from 24 to 0-1 when Cart active, (3) bg-hero aurora is still visible on each tab. Also consider veil opacity tuning per Home design_issue.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: react-navigation Bottom Tabs mount ALL tab screens once visited and layers them in the TabView container. Previously the F2F2F2 opaque scene wrapper masked inactive tabs. When the fix set both colors.card:'transparent' AND sceneContainerStyle:'transparent', the masking disappeared, exposing all mounted tab trees on top of the aurora simultaneously. Reproduction: (1) open app, (2) tap Cart tab, (3) observe Home content (FreshncuT logo, video banner) painting on top of the aurora and behind the Cart modal. DOM query returns 24 x 'Deliver to Bengaluru' when Cart is active. Mitigation: set unmountOnBlur: true (or freezeOnBlur: true, or detachInactiveScreens: true) on the Tabs so only the active tab is painted, letting the aurora show through only that one.
